title: 从不敢收费到年入50万美元，他花了5年
title_en: From Scared to Charge to $500K/Year, It Took 5 Years
title_jp: 課金が怖かった状態から年収50万ドルまで5年かかった
title_ar: من الخوف من فرض الرسوم إلى 500 ألف دولار سنويا، استغرق 5 سنوات

{"ops": [{"insert": "从不敢收费到年入50万美元，他花了5年"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说：收费让产品变真实了，我害怕那种感觉", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant McConnaughey以前做的项目，全都免费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开源Python包。Django工具。自动化代码检查服务Lintly，几百个用户，就是不收费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""收费让产品变真实。付费用户会对宕机和功能有真实期待。我没那个信心。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年1月，他给自己定了个新年目标——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在网上赚1美元。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听起来很卑微对吧？但对独立开发者来说，这是里程碑："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "终于做出了别人觉得有价值的东西。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant当时在一家保险公司当工程总监。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "_role越来越偏管理，开始怀念写代码。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他选了个niche idea——Postpone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当时只做Reddit的排期发布和数据分析。为什么选这个？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他用Reddit，熟悉平台和社区文化", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Buffer和Hootsuite不做Reddit", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以写博客讲做Postpone的过程，然后用Postpone发到Reddit， grow following", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "天时地利人和。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年1月开始做，10周后上线。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP极其简单——只能排期发Reddit帖子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有数据分析。没有最佳发布时间查询。没有内容库。更不支持现在那12个社交平台。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "全部自掏腰包，但也没多少成本。主要用AWS Free Tier。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "上线的样子？Grant自己都说"尴尬"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后疫情来了。 Grant和妻子 social distance，几乎不出门，也没孩子（当时）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每天晚上大量时间，埋头做Postpone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "多久才有第一个付费用户？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "3个月。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年6月。虽然3月就上线了，但直到6月才有人付钱。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "定价多少？最便宜3美元/月。最贵的25美元/月。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在回头看，Grant笑说这"可笑"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的定价建议很简单——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你很可能收太少了。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "独立开发者普遍定价过低。客户月付200美元眼都不眨，消费者宁可每天8美元买星巴克，也不愿月付5美元买App。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做B2B，别做B2C。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年秋天，他们涨价20%，对新注册和激活毫无影响。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant怎么找客户的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期很难。Twitter上喊没用，没人鸟你。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做了个" clever, scrappy"的事——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Reddit API下载了几百万帖子数据，按作者分组，找出发帖最多的5000+人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些人最可能受益于Postpone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后他写脚本，给这些人发Cold DM，邀请免费试用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一般般。Cold DM成功率极低。而且这样做有账号被封的风险。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他说是"clever, scrappy marketing tactics"的例子——当你零客户、没什么可失去时，可以试试。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在Postpone的营销更成熟了："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO（博客内容+程序化SEO）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rewardful联盟营销", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Userlist生命周期邮件", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Google Ads", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO带来最多用户。他们用丰富的社交媒体发帖数据，做博客文章和分析工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "联盟营销也很给力，几年带来近20万美元收入。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年夏天，危机来了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant全职做Postpone 7个月，妻子怀孕4个月。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reddit突然宣布要对API收费，就像Twitter/X那样。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而那时Postpone还是Reddit-only工具。API收费可能成为 existential threat。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant找Rob Walling聊，建议他："赶紧扩展到Reddit之外，降低平台风险。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是他和合伙人Valdir大改前后端，加了其他社交平台支持。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "到2024年秋天，Postpone支持12个平台，风险大大降低。还跟Reddit谈妥， survive了API收费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原来是危机，结果让Postpone比以前更强大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant成功的核心素质："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一致性。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "近5年来一直持续做Postpone。这是成功的第一要素。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "全面。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不是前端专家，也不是设计专家、文案专家、客服专家、产品经理专家。但他样样都懂一点。这在 small startup 里特别有用，每天要戴不同帽子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "快速决策。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他决策极快，有时会做错要撤回。但大多数时候这是优势。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""有些决策总比没决策好。大部分决策是'双向门'，错了可以逆转。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "快速执行带来的speed，让大公司的官僚流程相形见绌，能 impress 客户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grant的故事听起来现实多了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是一夜成名。没有 viral growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就是持续5年，一步步走过来。从不敢收费，到年入50万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说长期目标是继续慢慢做Postpone，希望有一天能以改变人生的价格卖掉它。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但现阶段目标很简单——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赚够钱，不用为钱担心。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "享受这一生。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前两个目标都达成了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: From not daring to charge to five hundred thousand dollars annual income took five years. He said charging makes product feel real I fear that feeling. Grant McConnaughey previous projects were all free. Open source Python package. Django tools. Automated code check serviceLintly hundreds of users just not charging. Why. Charging makes product feel real. Paying users have real expectations for downtime and features. I did not have confidence. January twenty twenty he set New Year goal make one dollar online. Sounds humble right. But for independent developer this is milestone finally made something others find valuable. One. Grant was engineering director at insurance company. Role increasingly management started missing coding. He picked niche idea Postpone. At that time only did Reddit scheduled posting and data analysis. Why pick this. He used Reddit familiar with platform and community culture. Buffer and Hootsuite did not do Reddit. Could write blog about building Postpone process then post to Reddit using Postpone grow following. Perfect timing. Two. Started in January twenty twenty ten weeks later launched. MVP extremely simple could only schedule Reddit posts.
